title: Reform UK launches its own ‘newspaper’ with Farage on front page
summary_full: Party aims to build a ‘significant national publishing operation’ as first edition of the Reformer is distributedUK politics live – latest updatesReform UK has launched what it is calling a newspaper, featuring large pictures of Nigel Farage, which the party hopes will replace mainstream media for its supporters.Though the party is hiring qualified journalists to write its newspapers, the only “reporter” credited with writing articles is Farage, the party leader.
